description: Show your respect and support for law enforcement officials with Rothco's Thin Blue Line Concealed Carry Bag. Constructed from rugged 600D polyester with a PVC coating and polypropylene webbing, this CCW bag is built for durability and long-lasting use. It features top carry handles and an adjustable/removable shoulder strap, providing multiple carry options to suit your needs. The concealed carry bag boasts a large main compartment, a sizable side pouch with a flap and quick-release buckles, and a large side zippered pouch with exterior MOLLE attachments. Additionally, the front of the bag includes 3 zippered pouches for organized storage. The rear zippered pocket has a loop patch for hook and loop attachment, offering secure storage options. Proceeds from the purchase of this bag benefit families of fallen first responders, making it a meaningful way to show your support. Whether you’re using it for work, travel, or everyday needs, Rothco's Thin Blue Line Bag combines functionality, durability, and a strong message of support for law enforcement.
